1	---
2	- name: Install dnsmasq
3	  package:
4	    name: dnsmasq
5	    state: present
6	  become: yes
7	
8	- name: Get Tailscale IPv4 address
9	  command: tailscale ip --4
10	  register: tailscale_ip_result
11	  changed_when: false
12	  failed_when: tailscale_ip_result.rc != 0
13	
14	- name: Set tailscale_ip fact
15	  set_fact:
16	    tailscale_ip: "{{ tailscale_ip_result.stdout | trim }}"
17	
18	- name: Ensure dnsmasq.d directory exists
19	  file:
20	    path: /etc/dnsmasq.d
21	    state: directory
22	    mode: '0755'
23	    owner: root
24	    group: root
25	  become: yes
26	
27	- name: Deploy dnsmasq config for {{ local_domain }}
28	  copy:
29	    dest: /etc/dnsmasq.d/{{ dnsmasq_conf_name }}
30	    mode: '0644'
31	    owner: root
32	    group: root
33	    content: |
34	      # Listen only on the Tailscale interface
35	      listen-address={{ tailscale_ip }}
36	      bind-interfaces
37	
38	      # Forward {{ local_domain }} queries to the local router
39	      server=/{{ local_domain }}/{{ local_router }}
40	
41	      # Return this node's Tailscale IP for its own hostname so remote
42	      # clients (connected via Tailscale) get a routable address
43	      address=/{{ ansible_hostname }}.{{ local_domain }}/{{ tailscale_ip }}
44	
45	      # Don't read /etc/resolv.conf for upstream servers
46	      no-resolv
47	
48	      # Don't cache negative results aggressively
49	      neg-ttl=30
50	  become: yes
51	  notify: Restart dnsmasq
52	
53	- name: Ensure systemd drop-in directory exists for dnsmasq
54	  file:
55	    path: /etc/systemd/system/dnsmasq.service.d
56	    state: directory
57	    mode: '0755'
58	    owner: root
59	    group: root
60	  become: yes
61	
62	- name: Deploy wait-for-tailscale systemd drop-in
63	  copy:
64	    dest: /etc/systemd/system/dnsmasq.service.d/wait-for-tailscale.conf
65	    mode: '0644'
66	    owner: root
67	    group: root
68	    content: |
69	      [Unit]
70	      After=tailscaled.service
71	      Wants=tailscaled.service
72	
73	      [Service]
74	      ExecStartPre=/bin/sh -c 'for i in $(seq 1 {{ tailscale_wait_seconds | int // 2 }}); do ip addr show tailscale0 2>/dev/null | grep -q {{ tailscale_ip }} && exit 0; sleep 2; done; exit 1'
75	  become: yes
76	  notify: Reload systemd daemon
77	
78	- name: Flush handlers so daemon-reload runs before start
79	  meta: flush_handlers
80	
81	- name: Ensure dnsmasq is enabled and started
82	  systemd:
83	    name: dnsmasq
84	    enabled: yes
85	    state: started
86	  become: yes
87
